9697: Today we're going back to 1996-97. The Bulls won 69 games and rolled to their fifth title — peak MJ, peak everyone trying to stop him. Good luck.
9798: Today we're going back to 1997-98. Michael Jordan's last dance with the Bulls. The Flu Game, The Shot over Russell, ring number six. Good luck.

9900: Today we're going back to 1999-2000. Shaq at his absolute peak — MVP, FMVP, the start of the Lakers' three-peat. Good luck.

0607: Today we're going back to 2006-07. Dirk MVP, the Mavs upset by Golden State's We Believe, and Tim Duncan's Spurs sweeping LeBron's first Finals. Good luck.
0708: Today we're going back to 2007-08. Boston's new Big Three — KG, Pierce, Allen — and a banner that ended a 22-year drought. Good luck.
